**Initiating Translation Project**

I'm starting a project to translate QA probes about astronomical objects from English to Simplified Chinese. The initial focus is on translating "2024 YR4" to "近地天体" (near-Earth object) and "2025 GN1" to "近地小行星" (near-Earth asteroid). I'm carefully considering the nuanced differences in terminology.
